title: Double Drip 10K Cherry Cola Prefilled Vape Pods + Refill
description: Keep your Double Drip 10K Pod Kit filled with your favourite flavour using this handy Prefilled Pod & Refill Pack. Each pack includes a 2ml prefilled pod and a 10ml refill bottle of 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, designed to deliver up to 10,000 puffs per device (based on individual use), with consistently smooth vapour and flavourful performance. Cherry Cola delivers a nostalgic, soda-inspired experience with juicy Cherry layered over a rich, spiced Cola base. Sweet and tangy with a touch of fizz, it’s a satisfying all-day vape for fruit and beverage fans alike. When it’s time to refresh your device, simply replace the pod and refill and let the auto-refill system continue delivering clean, flavour-rich vapour without interruption.
